items.tagline: Smarter systems for SMBs — we automate sales, ops, and admin so you save time, cut costs, and scale faster.
items.description:
At SMB Ops, we help small and mid-sized businesses run smarter by automating the busywork that slows growth. Our focus is simple: design and manage workflows that give owners back their time while improving accuracy, speed, and customer experience.

Why it matters: Studies show 89% of small businesses now use some form of AI or automation, and companies that adopt automation see an average of $5.44 return for every $1 invested. For SMB owners juggling sales, operations, and admin, this shift is no longer optional — it’s the new baseline for efficiency and growth.

What we do:
• Automate invoicing, payments, and reporting to keep cash flow healthy.
• Build AI-powered sales and marketing workflows that qualify leads, send personalized follow-ups, and boost conversion rates.
• Connect tools like QuickBooks, Jobber, Stripe, Airtable, and Google Workspace into one seamless system.
• Design dashboards that give real-time visibility into KPIs and savings.
• Provide ongoing automation management and documentation so your team always stays in sync.

Our edge: We don’t just “set up zaps.” We combine low-code platforms with AI and process design to create sustainable, documented systems tailored to your business. Think of us as a fractional operations team — giving you enterprise-level automation without enterprise-level cost.

Whether you run a home services company, med spa, law firm, or retail operation, SMB Ops is here to streamline your workflows, reduce overhead, and help you grow with confidence.

similarOrganizations.name: Planeo
similarOrganizations.description:
Vi tilbyr et samlet og enhetlig system for hele planprosessen, som ivaretar utvikling og historikk i prosessen. Planeo visualiserer en plan på en forståelig og intuitiv måte for alle berørte parter, både underveis i prosessen, i samhandlingsrommet med det offentlige og for berørt publikum. Dette sikrer gode utredninger, gode beslutninger og demokratisk medvirkning.

Arealplanprosesser er kompliserte, tidkrevende og kostbare. De består ofte av en enorm mengde og versjoner av dokumenter, filer, data og kart som ikke “snakker” godt nok sammen. Underveis i utviklingen av en plan får man en ganske uoversiktlig og kompleks situasjon knyttet til både å forstå hva som gjelder og hvor man er i planprosessen. Dette forlenger planprosessen og kompliserer ytterligere muligheten det offentlige og samfunnet for øvrig har til å sette seg inn i og forstå planen som foreligger. Dette resulterer i dårligere planprosesser som ofte drar unødvendig ut i tid, som igjen fører til unødvendig lang kapitalbinding og til slutt dyrere boliger. Planeo skal være en samhandlingsplattform for tiltakshaver og alle fag som bidrar underveis i prosessen. Vi skal ha integrert kartløsninger og hente data fra offentlige registre og fagverktøy. Planeo skal også presentere en plan på en mer visuell og forståelig måte, for å sikre åpenhet og medvirkning fra alle berørte parter.

items.name: Budget Workflow Automation
items.description:
Budget Workflow Automation offers inexpensive, easy to use solutions focusing on business process automation. Any task performed on a computer can be automated without replacing the software you already use with robotic process automation. Repetitive tasks can be automated, allowing staff to get more done. The need to hire temporary staff can also be avoided or greatly reduced. Our scripts take control of a workstation just like someone is at the keyboard. Scripts can be programmed to make routine decisions and can interact with a user as needed. They are more than macro recordings; they are like an invisible person at the keyboard.

For many offices, budget constraints mean paying people to repeat tasks rather than paying to purchase or develop more efficient software. We customize free automation software to control the programs you already use on the hardware you already own.
